mapper.select: SELECT template_id, template_nm, description, field_schema, file_atch_posbl_at, use_at, frst_register_id, frst_regist_pnttm, last_updusr_id, last_update_pnttm FROM APV_TEMPLATE ORDER BY template_id DESC

SELECT template_id, template_nm, description, field_schema, file_atch_posbl_at, use_at, frst_register_id, frst_regist_pnttm, last_updusr_id, last_update_pnttm FROM APV_TEMPLATE WHERE use_at = 'Y' ORDER BY template_id DESC

SELECT template_id, template_nm, description, field_schema, file_atch_posbl_at, use_at, frst_register_id, frst_regist_pnttm, last_updusr_id, last_update_pnttm FROM APV_TEMPLATE WHERE template_id = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APV_TEMPLATE (template_nm, description, field_schema, file_atch_posbl_at, frst_register_id) VALUES (#{templateNm}, #{description}, #{fieldSchema}, #{fileAtchPosblAt}, #{frstRegisterId})
mapper.update: UPDATE APV_TEMPLATE SET template_nm = #{templateNm}, description = #{description}, field_schema = #{fieldSchema}, file_atch_posbl_at = #{fileAtchPosblAt}, last_updusr_id = #{lastUpdusrId}, last_update_pnttm = NOW() WHERE template_id = #{templateId}
UPDATE APV_TEMPLATE SET use_at = #{useAt}, last_update_pnttm = NOW() WHERE template_id = #{templateId}
